_note: CSS selectors for BOOTH pages. Every entry starts null/unverified. Fill one only after seeing it in a real snapshot (see `discover-selectors`), and record the snapshot file and date in evidence. Never guess.

listing.card.evidence: 2026-10-21 listing_Tabletop_RPG_p1/p2, listing_Tabletop_Games_p1/p2 (/en/browse): exactly 60 per page, 60 unique IDs, data-product-position 0-59, no item links outside cards, no ID shared between the 4 pages. Card also carries data-product-id/name/price/brand/category attributes.

listing.card_price.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 4 snapshots: 240/240 cards. Text is 'N JPY' or 'N JPY~' (~ = several variants, N = lowest); digits always equal data-product-price.

listing.card_shop.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 4 snapshots: 240/240 cards; the shop avatar img alt holds the same name. Shop URL is the parent a.item-card__shop-name-anchor href.

listing.card_like.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 4 snapshots: no like count in listing HTML. The card only has an empty div.js-item-card-wish-list-button[data-item-id] filled by JavaScript. Keep null; use item JSON wish_lists_count.

listing.pagination.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 4 snapshots: div.pager with a[rel=next], li.current, a.last-page (page=395 for Tabletop RPG = 60/page, matching 'Results 23,693 件'). <link rel=next> in head too.

detail.main.evidence: 2026-10-21 item_{1712065,3403696,3408537,3645142,3790708,3846658,4604659,5426186,590976,958529}.html (/ja/items): 1 match each; holds the left column (images, description, shop sections) and the right column (title, shop, variants). 0 links to other items inside, while the whole page has 8-23 (recommendations sit outside).

detail.description.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 10 items: the first p equals item JSON 'description' exactly (10/10). 8/10 items also have 2-8 section.shop__text blocks (h2 heading + p, 1,150-2,500 chars) that are NOT in the item JSON and often hold system / player count / play time. Parser joins all matches.

detail.variant.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 10 items: one li per item-JSON variation, same order, .variation-name text equals JSON name (10/10), .variation-price like '¥ 1,000'. data-product-variant (= JSON variation id) only on rows with a cart button; free_download and restock_not_requested rows have none (9 of 26 rows).

detail.like.evidence: 2026-10-21 same 10 items: like count not in the HTML at all (neither plain nor comma-formatted). Item JSON /ja/items/<id>.json has it as wish_lists_count (10/10, 4,020-29,017).
